topic: Smart Pointers and Automatic Memory Management in Modern C++
explanation: Smart pointers are template classes in C++ that automate memory management by ensuring proper resource deallocation when objects go out of scope. They help prevent memory leaks and dangling pointers, which are common pitfalls in manual memory management. Modern C++ (C++11 and beyond) introduces smart pointers such as std::unique_ptr, std::shared_ptr, and std::weak_ptr, each suited for different ownership semantics, promoting safer and more expressive code.
